notes.title: In My Brain is out now! Fight mental illness from the inside!
notes.notes:
[b]In My Brain is now out on Steam[/b]! Embark on a journey with [b]Nano[/b], a particle that can infiltrate people’s minds, and [b]help people with mental illnesses[/b] from inside the brain! You will be able to learn more about four of the most common mental illnesses: anorexia, schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder, all while solving puzzles and sorting out the obstacles you will encounter.

We believe [b]mental health awareness[/b] is incredibly important in this day and age. In My Brain was born with the aim to help people understand the importance of mental health, and to bring more awareness about the struggles that people with mental illnesses have to live with every day.

Thanks to the thorough research behind In My Brain and the real stories in it, we hope it will be able to resonate with many people and help them learn new things while having fun!

The game is also available in a pack together with [b]3 Chicas in Tech[/b], a metroidvania about women engineers!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45063/Special_Launch_Offer_In_My_Brain__3_Chicas_in_Tech_Combo/
